final_sql: SELECT * FROM books WHERE published_year > 2000

question: Show all active loans
expected_sql: SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE return_date IS NULL
final_sql:
SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    b.title AS book_title,
    b.author,
    m.name AS member_name,
    m.email,
    l.loan_date,
    l.due_date
FROM loans l
JOIN books b ON l.book_id = b.book_id
JOIN members m ON l.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE l.return_date IS NULL;

question: List loans with book titles
expected_sql: SELECT books.title FROM loans JOIN books ON loans.book_id = books.book_id
final_sql:

FROM loans l

question: Show loans with member names
expected_sql: SELECT members.name FROM loans JOIN members ON loans.member_id = members.member_id

question: Which member has borrowed the most books?
expected_sql: SELECT member_id FROM loans GROUP BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
final_sql:
SELECT m.member_id, m.name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_books_borrowed
FROM members m
JOIN loans l ON m.member_id = l.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.name
ORDER BY total_books_borrowed DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: List books that have never been loaned
expected_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE book_id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM loans)
final_sql:
SELECT b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.genre, b.published_year
FROM books b
LEFT JOIN loans l ON b.book_id = l.book_id
WHERE l.loan_id IS NULL

question: How many books did each member borrow?
expected_sql: SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) FROM loans GROUP BY member_id
final_sql:
SELECT m.member_id, m.name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS books_borrowed
FROM members m
LEFT JOIN loans l ON m.member_id = l.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.name
ORDER BY books_borrowed DESC;

question: Show overdue loans
expected_sql: SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE return_date > due_date
final_sql:
SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    m.name AS member_name,
    m.email AS member_email,
    b.title AS book_title,
    b.author,
    l.loan_date,
    l.due_date,
    CAST(JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(l.due_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue
FROM loans l
JOIN members m ON l.member_id = m.member_id
JOIN books b ON l.book_id = b.book_id
WHERE l.return_date IS NULL
  AND l.due_date < DATE('now')
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC;

question: What is the most popular genre by total copies?
expected_sql: SELECT genre FROM books GROUP BY genre ORDER BY SUM(total_copies) DESC LIMIT 1
final_sql:
SELECT genre, SUM(total_copies) AS total_copies_count
FROM books
GROUP BY genre
ORDER BY total_copies_count DESC
LIMIT 1
